cc:Work.dc:description: Full 66-task source jobs. Oracle pass@1–5 and reconstructed selection stars using GPT-5.6 Sol at k=5. Homogeneous pools assume valid selection; unreviewed mixed pools use uniform fallback. No tasks are removed from the denominator.
